\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{جوا} (juā)}{جوا (juā)}]{\ur{جوا} (juā) — gambling}

\label{lesson:UR-C533-jua}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a draw (of lots), then the Urdu for a toss (of a coin).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{جوا}}
\textbf{\ur{جوا}} — \emph{juā} — \textquotedblleft{}gambling\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{تم} \ur{نے} \ur{جوا} \ur{کھیلا} \ur{تو} \ur{سب} \ur{ہار} \ur{جاؤ} \ur{گے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar tum ne juā khelā to sab hār jāo ge.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you gamble, you will lose everything.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{جوا}} (\emph{juā}) is inherited from Sanskrit \emph{dyūta}, \textquotedblleft{}gambling\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 6608).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{juā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{juā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar tum ne juā khelā to sab hār jāo ge.} — If you gamble, you will lose everything.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for a draw (of lots), then the Urdu for a toss (of a coin), then say \emph{juā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{جوا} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Gambling\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{پانسہ} (pāṅsā)}{پانسہ (pāṅsā)}]{\ur{پانسہ} (pāṅsā) — a die (for a game)}

\label{lesson:UR-C533-pansa}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a toss (of a coin), then the Urdu for gambling.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{پانسہ}}
\textbf{\ur{پانسہ}} — \emph{pāṅsā} — \textquotedblleft{}a die (for a game)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{پانسے} \ur{پر} \ur{چھ} \ur{آیا} \ur{تو} \ur{میں} \ur{جیتوں} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar pāṅse par chhe āyā to maiṅ jītūṅ gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the die shows a six, I'll win.
\end{quote}

Masculine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{پانسہ}} (\emph{pāṅsā}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{pāsā}, \textquotedblleft{}a die\textquotedblright{}, under Sanskrit \emph{pāśa}, \textquotedblleft{}a die, dice\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 8132).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pāṅsā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar pāṅse par chhe āyā to maiṅ jītūṅ gā.} — If the die shows a six, I'll win.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for a toss (of a coin), then the Urdu for gambling, then say \emph{pāṅsā} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{باری} (bārī)}{باری (bārī)}]{\ur{باری} (bārī) — a turn (in a game); one's turn}

\label{lesson:UR-C533-bari}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for gambling, then the Urdu for a die.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{باری}}
\textbf{\ur{باری}} — \emph{bārī} — \textquotedblleft{}a turn (in a game); one's turn\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{کی} \ur{باری} \ur{ہے} \ur{تو} \ur{پانسہ} \ur{پھینکیے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp kī bārī hai to pāṅsā pheṅkiye.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If it's your turn, throw the die.
\end{quote}

Feminine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{باری}} (\emph{bārī}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{bārī}, \textquotedblleft{}a turn, a time\textquotedblright{}, under Sanskrit \emph{vāra} (CDIAL 11547).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{چال} (chāl)}{چال (chāl)}]{\ur{چال} (chāl) — a move (in a game)}

\label{lesson:UR-C533-chal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a die, then the Urdu for a turn (in a game).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{چال}}
\textbf{\ur{چال}} — \emph{chāl} — \textquotedblleft{}a move (in a game)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{وہ} \ur{یہ} \ur{چال} \ur{سمجھ} \ur{گیا} \ur{تو} \ur{جیت} \ur{جائے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar voh yih chāl samajh gayā to jīt jāe gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If he sees through this move, he will win.
\end{quote}

Feminine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{چال}} (\emph{chāl}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{cāl}, \textquotedblleft{}behaviour\textquotedblright{}, under \emph{*calyā}, \textquotedblleft{}gait, conduct\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 4722); the sense \textquotedblleft{}a move in a game\textquotedblright{} is a later one that CDIAL does not record.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{پلٹانا} (palṭānā)}{پلٹانا (palṭānā)}]{\ur{پلٹانا} (palṭānā) — to turn over (something)}

\label{lesson:UR-C533-paltana}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for a turn (in a game), then the Urdu for a move (in a game).
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{پلٹانا}}
\textbf{\ur{پلٹانا}} — \emph{palṭānā} — \textquotedblleft{}to turn over (something)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{اگر} \ur{آپ} \ur{نے} \ur{پتا} \ur{پلٹایا} \ur{تو} \ur{کھیل} \ur{بدل} \ur{جائے} \ur{گا۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{agar āp ne pattā palṭāyā to khel badal jāe gā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you turn the card over, the game will change.
\end{quote}

Past, with \ur{نے} (he or she …): \ur{اس} \ur{نے} \ur{پتا} \ur{پلٹایا}, \emph{us ne pattā palṭāyā}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{پلٹانا}} (\emph{palṭānā}) is inherited: CDIAL lists the Hindi cousin \emph{palṭānā}, \textquotedblleft{}to turn\textquotedblright{}, under \emph{*pallaṭṭ}, a form it reconstructs (CDIAL 7968).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{palṭānā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{palṭānā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{agar āp ne pattā palṭāyā to khel badal jāe gā.} — If you turn the card over, the game will change.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for a turn (in a game), then the Urdu for a move (in a game), then say \emph{palṭānā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{پلٹانا} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To turn over (something)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Before the Deadline to A Game of Chance}

\label{lesson:UR-R533-review-526-533}



\begin{quote}
Say the Urdu for a time limit and fixed in advance.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a time limit, fixed in advance, urgent, a break in work, complete
  \item busy, not busy, available, an excuse, to get bored
  \item a blessing, spiritual merit, an amulet, an offering, to bestow favour on
  \item a tiresome muddle, a quandary, an inner struggle, complicated, to tangle
  \item one's own choice, willing, a disagreement, turned down, to turn back
  \item something left in one's keeping, one's given word, honouring a rule, a good name, to be kept up
  \item luck, destiny, a lottery, a draw (of lots), a toss (of a coin)
  \item gambling, a die, a turn (in a game), a move (in a game), to turn over
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A time limit? (\textbf{\ur{میعاد}}, \emph{mīād}.) Fixed in advance? (\textbf{\ur{مقررہ}}, \emph{muqarrarā}.) Urgent? (\textbf{\ur{فوری}}, \emph{faurī}.) A break in work? (\textbf{\ur{وقفہ}}, \emph{vaqfā}.) Complete? (\textbf{\ur{مکمل}}, \emph{mukammal}.) Busy? (\textbf{\ur{مصروف}}, \emph{masrūf}.) Not busy? (\textbf{\ur{فارغ}}, \emph{fārigh}.) Available? (\textbf{\ur{دستیاب}}, \emph{dastyāb}.) An excuse? (\textbf{\ur{بہانہ}}, \emph{bahānā}.) To get bored? (\textbf{\ur{اوبنا}}, \emph{ūbnā}.) A blessing? (\textbf{\ur{برکت}}, \emph{barkat}.) Spiritual merit? (\textbf{\ur{ثواب}}, \emph{savāb}.) An amulet? (\textbf{\ur{تعویذ}}, \emph{tāvīz}.) An offering? (\textbf{\ur{نذرانہ}}, \emph{nazrānā}.) To bestow favour on? (\textbf{\ur{نوازنا}}, \emph{navāznā}.) A tiresome muddle? (\textbf{\ur{جھمیلا}}, \emph{jhamelā}.) A quandary? (\textbf{\ur{مخمصہ}}, \emph{makhmasā}.) An inner struggle? (\textbf{\ur{کشمکش}}, \emph{kashmakash}.) Complicated? (\textbf{\ur{پیچیدہ}}, \emph{pechīdā}.) To tangle? (\textbf{\ur{الجھانا}}, \emph{uljhānā}.) One's own choice? (\textbf{\ur{مرضی}}, \emph{marzī}.) Willing? (\textbf{\ur{راضی}}, \emph{rāzī}.) A disagreement? (\textbf{\ur{اختلاف}}, \emph{ikhtilāf}.) Turned down? (\textbf{\ur{مسترد}}, \emph{mustarad}.) To turn back? (\textbf{\ur{پلٹنا}}, \emph{palaṭnā}.) Something left in one's keeping? (\textbf{\ur{امانت}}, \emph{amānat}.) One's given word? (\textbf{\ur{قول}}, \emph{qaul}.) Honouring a rule? (\textbf{\ur{پاسداری}}, \emph{pāsdārī}.) A good name? (\textbf{\ur{ساکھ}}, \emph{sākh}.) To be kept up? (\textbf{\ur{نبھنا}}, \emph{nibhnā}.) Luck? (\textbf{\ur{قسمت}}, \emph{qismat}.) Destiny? (\textbf{\ur{تقدیر}}, \emph{taqdīr}.) A lottery? (\textbf{\ur{لاٹری}}, \emph{lāṭrī}.) A draw (of lots)? (\textbf{\ur{قرعہ}}, \emph{qurā}.) A toss (of a coin)? (\textbf{\ur{ٹاس}}, \emph{ṭās}.) Gambling? (\textbf{\ur{جوا}}, \emph{juā}.) A die? (\textbf{\ur{پانسہ}}, \emph{pāṅsā}.) A turn (in a game)? (\textbf{\ur{باری}}, \emph{bārī}.) A move (in a game)? (\textbf{\ur{چال}}, \emph{chāl}.) To turn over? (\textbf{\ur{پلٹانا}}, \emph{palṭānā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
